title: Fraction Smash
topic: Equations with fractions: clear the denominators

scenes.say: Math Blitz, day five! You crushed The Hand-Off, so let's level up: Fraction Smash! Fractions in your equation? One big multiply smashes every bottom.

scenes.heading: SMASH THE BOTTOM
scenes.note: EVERY term gets the × 3, not just the fraction.
scenes.say: x over three plus two equals six. Multiply every term by three. x plus six equals eighteen, so x equals twelve.

scenes.heading: TWO BOTTOMS? USE THE LCD
scenes.say: Two bottoms? Find the smallest number they both go into: six. Multiply every term by six. Three x plus two x equals thirty.

scenes.heading: FINISH IT
scenes.say: Team up: five x equals thirty, so x equals six. Check it: three plus two is five. Nothing but net!

scenes.ask: What is the value of x?
scenes.say: Your turn, champ! Twenty five XP on the line. x plus one, over four, plus x over two, equals seven. Smash those bottoms! What is x? Tap your answer below the video!

question.prompt: (x + 1)/4 + x/2 = 7. What is the value of x?
question.explain: Multiply every term by 4: (x + 1) + 2x = 28. Team up: 3x + 1 = 28, so 3x = 27 and x = 9. Check: 10/4 + 9/2 = 2.5 + 4.5 = 7.

trap_notes.2: Multiplied x/2 by 2 instead of 4 (x + 1 + x = 28)
trap_notes.3: Stopped at 3x = 27 and forgot to divide by 3

rapid.prompt: Mia spent 1/4 of her money on a game and $12 on snacks: half her money in all. How much did she start with?

rapid.why: × 10 every term: 5x + 2x = 140, so 7x = 140. No need to find x!
